# A word of caution on Pull Requests (PRs)  

This project happily accepts pull requests under the following conditions:
- Changes need to be proposed first, either in a GitHub discussion, GitHub issue or via personal e-mail communication
- Each matter of change comes in one PR, do not throw together several matters into one PR
- You may use AI as long as you can explain every single line of code that AI has written for you. This includes especially code that deals with bus telegrams and other related matters where AI usually has no clue, but pretends otherwise. If you can't do it, don't submit it.
- If it is evident that you just told AI to write code to do X, your PR will be rejected. Break this rule repeatedly and you will be banned.

Does your PR meet these criteria? Then I sincerely thank you for your willingness to help this project in a meaningful way!
